title: Subsets of the Real Numbers
seo_title: Grade 7 Subsets of Real Numbers Worksheets with Answers (MATATAG Math 7)
standard_text: Illustrate the different subsets of real numbers.
meta_desc: Free Grade 7 real number worksheets for the DepEd MATATAG curriculum: natural numbers, whole numbers, integers, rational and irrational numbers. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: Irrational numbers are real but not rational.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Natural (counting) numbers: 1, 2, 3, … Whole numbers: 0, 1, 2, 3, …
  • Integers: …, −2, −1, 0, 1, 2, …
  • Rational numbers can be written as a fraction of integers: −3, 0.25, 23, 0.333…
  • Irrational numbers cannot: √2, π. Rational and irrational numbers together make the real numbers. Each set sits inside the next: natural ⊂ whole ⊂ integers ⊂ rational ⊂ real.

Examples

Example

−7

not whole

integer

rational

real

Answer: integer, rational, real

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Fractions are not rationalEvery fraction of integers is rational.
Negatives as whole numbersWhole numbers start at 0.
Every root is irrational√25 = 5 is rational.
